prompt.text: Should cities invest in reliable public transport?

drafts.original: Public transport can improve the lives of residents because it reduces traffic and makes daily travel cheaper. For example, a reliable bus network allows students to reach their classes without buying a car. Local authorities should therefore invest in frequent services and safe stations. These investments also support shops by making neighbourhoods easier to visit.
drafts.revision: Public transport can improve the lives of residents because it reduces traffic and makes daily travel cheaper. For example, a reliable bus network allows students to reach their classes without buying a car. Local authorities should therefore invest in frequent services and safe stations. These investments also support shops by making neighbourhoods easier to visit. Another advantage is that workers can travel to different neighbourhoods and find jobs without having to pay for parking. This improves access to employment and can help households save money over the course of a year.
